ideas.idea: Prerender / (and /guides) as alternative to removing ssr:false
ideas.why: It is a concrete option in nuxt.config that gives crawlers real HTML while keeping the SPA config.

ideas.idea: Fill in the guides page with actual routes, grades, distance and difficulty as text
ideas.why: guides.vue has only a heading and a promise sentence, so adding the routes gives the page real content.

ideas.idea: Give each route its own page at /guides/<route> linked from /guides
ideas.why: It gives each walk its own URL and title, and the site currently has no content pages.

ideas.idea: Add a short intro to the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so an intro adds real descriptive text.

ideas.idea: Add canonical links per page using the real domain
ideas.why: No canonical is set anywhere, and the sitemap uses a placeholder domain.

ideas.idea: Declare a site URL in config (runtimeConfig.public) shared by canonicals, sitemap and social tags
ideas.why: It is sensible but only helps indirectly and is a general Nuxt practice.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD with the site name and URL
ideas.why: It is accurate but of little effect for a tiny site, and it applies to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
ideas.why: It improves link previews but would apply to any site and does little for being found or understood.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: It is a standard sitemap enhancement with little effect on a two-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Use a Nuxt sitemap module to generate the sitemap from routes
ideas.why: It is reasonable as the site grows, but it is general advice and the current two-URL sitemap is valid.
